summary: NCLAT stayed and kept in abeyance the NCLT order admitting Polycab India Limited into CIRP over an alleged operational debt of ₹2.79 crore.
quote: has stayed and kept in abeyance the order dated October 07, 2026 passed by the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal, Ahmedabad Bench, for admission of the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process ("CIRP") C.P .(IB)No.273/9/ AHM/2026, in the matter of Asier Metals Private Limited vs. Polycab India Limited
